crossRefs.note: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.
Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow…
Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness…
that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…

translations.web: the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
translations.bsb: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
translations.kjv: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
